whenToUse: You need files such as proof documents, a résumé, or photos.
People upload several files at once.
There are type and size limits.
whenNotToUse: A single photo must be cropped or adjusted right away (use with an image cropper).
Very large files (they need progress notices and resumable uploads).
Taking a photo with the camera is the main use on phones (consider the capture attribute).

alternatives.name: Progress Toast
alternatives.reason: Showing progress when uploading takes a while.

accessibility: The drop area is a label wrapping a real file input, so keyboard and screen reader users use it like a button.
While dragging, the border and background change to show where to drop.
Rejected files are explained with role="status".
Remove buttons in the list include the file name, such as "Remove receipt.jpg".
